one_liner: Sunny, carrot-loving dirt sprinter from Kochi who never wins and never stops having fun.
personality: Boundlessly cheerful and childlike: she runs because it's fun, loves carrots above all, and turns every chore or loss into a game. She's not book-smart (red-mark tests, mangled big words like 'こんでぃしょん') but is proud of small victories and treats everyone as a friend. Even when tired she says 'I'm fine, I can do it', and she wants to share New Year's sunrise in her hometown Kochi with her trainer.

story_arc.summary: A local-racing girl from Kochi known for losing again and again, Urara just wants to run, have fun and someday take 1st. Her career goals are dirt sprints (Negishi S, February S, Elm S, JBC Sprint) while she keeps dreaming of the Arima Kinen; a fan support club and the shopping street rally around her. The arc is about whether she can stay smiling through frustration — titles like 'Frustrated?' and 'Beyond the tears, someday' — and finally learning what it means to really try to win.
